svg.title: 64 GB CMP 170HX Memory & KV Modes
svg.desc:
64 GB CMP 170HX Memory & KV Modes Fixed 18.98 GB weight footprint leaves room for 516K lossless BF16 or 1.03M+ opt-in FP8 KV tokens per card States shown: Live. Solid lines: data flows today.
Blocks, left to right: - Shared Card Footprint (Native NVFP4 + MXFP8 (no re-quant)): Target weights: 18.98 GB; NVFP4_N1S1 (-1.27 GB); DSpark + fold: ~3.8 GB; SWA rings + CUDA graphs - Default: Lossless BF16 KV (Best N=4 M1: 323.8-360.6 tok/s (+25% vs Config B)): 504 global KV pages; 516,096 tokens / card; 4.13M tokens (8 cards); KL 0.00477 (98.04% top-1) - Opt-In: --kv-fp8 (E4M3 Global KV) (Fits 4 x 262K contexts / card (lossy, KL 0.0262)): 1,008+ global KV pages; 1.03M+ tokens / card; 8.26M+ tokens (8 cards); 4x8 120K decode: -16.6% Lines: - Shared Card Footprint -> Default: Lossless BF16 KV, labeled "default" - Shared Card Footprint -> Opt-In: --kv-fp8 (E4M3 Global KV), labeled "KV_FP8=1" Note: DFlash2 opt-in. Replacing DSpark with --draft-dflash2 frees an extra ~3.3 GiB VRAM per card.
